mnar.population: A+ complete-baseline participants with full administrative opportunity and documented survival through the end of the outcome window
mnar.estimand: Adjusted two-year CDR-SB level contrast across the target-population tau IQR, normalized per 0.1 SUVR; not the original repeated-measures trajectory estimand
mnar.assumptions: Delta and tau-gradient values are sensitivity assumptions, not estimated missingness effects or clinical thresholds. Unknown survival is excluded and counted. Death is not imputed as CDR-SB.
